# TPC-DS Q82 — Store Sales Inventory

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds
```

> [TPC-DS](../../tpc-ds.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS queries](index.md)

Reports items in inventory with specific constraints

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  i_current_price
FROM item, inventory, date_dim, store_sales
WHERE
  i_current_price BETWEEN 30 AND 30 + 30
  AND inv_item_sk = i_item_sk
  AND d_date_sk = inv_date_sk
  AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2002-05-30' AS DATE) AND (
    CAST('2002-05-30' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '60 DAY'
  )
  AND i_manufact_id IN (437, 129, 727, 663)
  AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 100 AND 500
  AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
GROUP BY
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  i_current_price
ORDER BY
  i_item_id
LIMIT 100
```
